title: Ideals are contracted from a faithfully flat extension
statement: Let $\varphi:R\to S$ be a faithfully flat ring map [def-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ring-map] of commutative rings and $I\subset R$ an ideal. Then $\varphi^{-1}(IS)=I$, where $IS$ is the ideal of $S$ generated by $\varphi(I)$. In particular ($I=0$) $\varphi$ is injective.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 05CK (lemma-faithfully-flat-universally-injective), second sentence: 'In particular R cap IS = I for any ideal I of R'
